description: Replacement-family member: Adapt fixed at keyword-high, Linha-Fina (trained statistical template classifier) fills the template-medium slot.
notes: FAMILY: tmpl-slot 4-way — mycroft-classic (adapt-high -> padatious-medium) is the shared baseline; siblings are tmpl-slot-nebulento, tmpl-slot-linhafina (this file), tmpl-slot-jurebes, each swapping only the template-medium engine with adapt-high held fixed. There is no separate tmpl-slot-padatious fighter: that config is identical to mycroft-classic, and per the 1-fighter-per-config rule mycroft-classic itself serves as the 'template engine = padatious' cell of this grid rather than duplicating the same pipeline under a second competitor_id. This sibling swaps in Linha-Fina, a distinct trained-classifier engine from Padatious and Jurebes (see ENGINE_REGISTRY import path 'linha_fina.opm:LinhaFinaPipeline'), with adapt-high held fixed as the front door. Never previously paired with plain Adapt in the registry (linha-fina does not appear in frankenparse/padapt/nebulatious/nebulapt/palavadapt), so this is the first head-to-head data point for Linha-Fina against the keyword-rule paradigm specifically.
